notes.title: Alpha Patch Notes – v0.2.7
notes.content:
Gameplay
-Adjusted overall difficulty balance for a more consistent challenge curve

UX/UI
-Added enemy health bar display to enhance combat readability
-Implemented new UX elements to support clarity and player feedback

Achievements
-Added a new unlockable achievement tied to exploration and progression

Bug Fixes

notes.title: Alpha Patch Notes – v0.2.6
notes.content:
Gameplay
-Added a new stage expanding narrative scope and progression possibilities
-Introduced a soul system that alters gameplay loops based on player state
-Implemented a mechanic to suppress soul effects, enabling alternative strategies
-Rebalanced difficulty curve to improve pacing and challenge consistency

Cutscenes
-Added new cutscenes tied to progression and soul mechanics
-Fixed inconsistencies in cutscene playback under specific conditions

Audio
-Introduced a dynamic background music system reacting to proximity
-Improved mix and spatialization of ambient audio and voice layers

Animation
-Polished several animation cycles for player and scripted sequences
-Resolved animation syncing issues during transitions and cutscenes

Performance
-Split certain large environments into separate phases to improve performance on lower-end hardware

UI/UX
-Added contextual tips to guide players through new mechanics

Bug Fixes
-Fixed rare damage spikes and unexpected player deaths in specific scenarios

notes.title: Alpha Patch Notes – v0.2.5
notes.content:

   -Added new contextual animations to enhance immersion during key scenes

Audio
   -Fixed spatial 3D audio inaccuracies in both indoor and outdoor environments
   -Improved positional sound effects for ambient and dynamic elements

Animation
   -Refined animation transitions
   -Fixed animation glitches during certain cutscenes

Performance
   -Optimized memory usage in complex scenes
   -Improved stability on low-end systems
